LESSON: LISTENING FOR GIST

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: GERMAN
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.9: Listening for gist
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening for gist, part of Listening and Speaking in Grade 5 GERMAN.

Key inquiry question: where classroom items are located (z.B. wo ist der Stuhl?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen to names of things in the classroom (z.B der Bleistift, die Tafel...),

2. listen to short simple texts on location of things in the classroom (z.B. der Bleistift ist auf dem Tisch...),

3. listen to words that depict location (z.B auf, in, unter...) and match to given pictures,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to names of things in the classroom (z.B der Bleistift, die Tafel...),
2. listen to short simple texts on location of things in the classroom (z.B. der Bleistift ist auf dem Tisch...),
3. listen to words that depict location (z.B auf, in, unter...) and match to given pictures,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening for gist together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Creativity and imagination: The learner undertakes tasks that make connections between object and location as they ask peers

where items in the classroom are located.

Values:
Responsibility: The learner organises classroom items in the right places as they listen to texts on location of classroom items

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Social cohesion: The learner engages in activities of listening and arranging items in the classroom in order.

Link to other Learning Areas

The learner links the concept of prepositions of location to the same concepts in English and Kiswahili.
